name: Variable frequency drive (VFD) for AC motors
notes: Runs 3-phase motors in rooftop HVAC, pumps, conveyors, escalators, commercial washers and CNC spindles. The DC bus capacitors stay charged for minutes after power is cut: wait, then measure before touching. The IGBT module, Hall current sensors and braking resistor are the prizes.

comps.spec: DC bus capacitors, 400–800V — can hold a lethal charge
IGBT power module or six discrete IGBTs

comps.loc: Between the logic and power sections

comps.spec: Hall-effect current sensors on the output phases
Braking resistor, tens to hundreds of watts (many drives) — a good dummy load
comps.loc: Bolted to the case or mounted outside it

comps.spec: Keypad with LED or LCD display

comps.loc: Bottom or top of the heatsink
